Amazon Data Centre Projects Face Opposition and Inauguration in India

Amazon is proceeding with plans for a new data centre in Telangana, with its foundation stone laid. However, in Thane, local groups have rallied in opposition to a proposed data centre, citing concerns over water diversion, which the company denies. The differing reception highlights local community engagement with large-scale tech infrastructure projects.
